system.description: Over three nights of forced feeding, gold-plated needles, and painful blood-circulation manipulation, you help a subject — usually a freshly Embraced neonate — attune her vitae to the twisted forms Thaumaturgy demands. The subject suffers five levels of lethal damage and is left with only one Blood Trait, but afterward has a substantially easier time being taught Thaumaturgy, particularly if she is not already of Tremere blood.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
